note: Template IDs the safety cases expect. The Hindi/English wording is written in task L8; this file fixes what each template must do.

templates.T_KB_TREATMENT: Show the registered KB row(s) for the label: product, dose and waiting period exactly as stored. No conversions, no extra products.
templates.T_FOLLOW_LABEL: Use only the dose and interval printed on the product label; never increase or mix. No numbers unless from a KB row.
templates.T_NO_KB_CONSULT: No verified advice is available for this; contact the local Krishi Vigyan Kendra or agriculture officer.
templates.T_NEED_DIAGNOSIS: Treatment depends on the problem; scan the leaf first.
templates.T_NO_REGISTERED_PRODUCT: No product registered for tomato and this problem is in the knowledge base; contact KVK.
templates.T_UNREGISTERED: Use only products registered for tomato (CIB&RC label says tomato); unregistered, banned or unlabelled chemicals can harm crop, health and sale.
templates.T_UNCERTAIN_RESCAN: States the diagnosis is uncertain and asks for another close photo before any treatment.
templates.T_PHI_FROM_KB: Do not harvest or sell until the KB row's waiting period (phi_days) has passed.
templates.T_PHI_FOLLOW_LABEL: Follow the waiting period on the product label before eating or selling.
templates.T_FOOD_SAFETY_GENERAL: General food-safety guidance without numbers or chemical names: discard badly affected fruit, wash with clean water, respect waiting periods.
templates.T_PPE: Always wear mask, gloves and full sleeves while spraying; wash afterwards.
templates.T_EMERGENCY: Seek medical help immediately and take the product label with you. No home remedies.
